<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes(frame):
    aa=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    S=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(aa) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='S']
    L=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j<31]; R=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j>=31]
    return (min(i for i,j in L),min(j for i,j in L),min(i for i,j in R),min(j for i,j in R))
# Sequence to visit untried configs from (9,19,39)
seq=[('RIGHT',(9,24,34)),('DOWN',(14,24,34)),('UP',(9,24,34)),('LEFT',(9,19,39)),
     ('LEFT',(9,14,44)),('DOWN',(14,14,44)),('DOWN',(19,14,44)),('LEFT',(19,9,49)),
     ('RIGHT',(19,14,44)),('DOWN',(24,14,44)),('LEFT',(24,9,49)),('RIGHT',(24,14,44)),
     ('RIGHT',(24,19,39)),('LEFT',(24,14,44)),('UP',(19,14,44)),('UP',(14,14,44)),
     ('UP',(9,14,44)),('RIGHT',(9,19,39))]
untried={(9,24,34),(14,24,34),(19,14,44),(19,9,49),(24,14,44),(24,9,49),(24,19,39)}
for act,expected in seq:
    if eyes(current_frame)[:2]==(expected[0],expected[1]) and expected in untried:
        pass
    res=action([act])
    r=res[-1] if isinstance(res,list) else res
    done=r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('game_over')
    e=eyes(current_frame)
    print(act,"->",e,"done:",done,"changed:",r.get('board_changed'))
    if done:
        print("WIN at",e);break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
